# P0-06 — The six missing Playwright specs

Lane `build/w0-p006-e2e` (`ed5c36c`), merged into `build/w0-consolidate`. Notes: `docs/build/lanes/P0-06-e2e.md`; decisions, app fixes, corrected tests and removals are folded into LEDGER.

- One config: root `playwright.config.ts` has `chromium`, `firefox` and `webkit` projects. `e2e/playwright.config.ts` is removed. The webServer (`scripts/e2e_serve.sh`) builds the production Worker bundle twice (default flags and all `VITE_QCOMPASS_*` flags) and serves both on workerd.
- New specs: `cosmology-regression`, `hep-particle-observables`, `nuclear-observables`, `gravity-provenance-guard` (a synthetic learned-Hamiltonian fixture with no warning is refused), `verdict-admin-gate` (non-admin can't see it), `domain-shell-coming-online`. Kept and corrected: `cosmology-byte-identity`, `chemistry-h2-flow`. Also passing: `smoke`, `visualizer-domain`.
- The specs found four app bugs, all fixed: run detail pages were unreachable (`runs.tsx` had no outlet), the configurator didn't navigate after submit, the verdict admin gate was client-side only (now requires the Supabase `admin` role), and the 404 head was missing from the SSR HTML.

## Run on the merged tree (`build/w0-consolidate`, after the merge)
`PW_CHROMIUM_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers/chromium bunx playwright test --project=chromium` → **41 passed** (2.5 min). The lane also ran all 41 three times against the committed baselines.
Frontend after the merge: `bunx tsc --noEmit` 0 errors · eslint 0 errors · prettier clean · Vitest 71 passed · `bun run build` exit 0.

## CI-PENDING
Firefox and WebKit can't run here: the session proxy blocks the browser downloads. In CI the `e2e` job installs all three. The first run writes the firefox/webkit cosmology baselines (`updateSnapshots: "missing"`) and reports those three tests as failed. The job uploads `e2e/__screenshots__/` as the `e2e-screenshots` artifact. Those PNGs get reviewed (real content, no error pages) and committed, then the job is re-run.

## Baselines regenerated on CI browsers (`2b59c0f`, via `.github/workflows/e2e-baselines.yml`)
I opened all nine PNGs (`e2e/__screenshots__/{chromium,firefox,webkit}/cosmology-byte-identity.spec.ts/{cosmology-default,cosmology-visualizer-index,cosmology-visualizer-kawai-kim-natural}.png`). Each shows real content:
- `/`: the Configurator, with the F1 η_B formula and "4 benchmarks available".
- `/visualizer`: the seven baked runs.
- `/visualizer/kawai-kim-natural`: all six panels. Phase space draws in 3D where the browser has WebGL; Firefox CI has none, so it uses the 2D fallback scatter.
No panel shows an error or "fetch failed". The magenta bar is the masked build-stamp footer. The sandbox-rendered Chromium baselines were replaced by CI's Chromium output.
